top_signals.title: The Icelandic DNA Behind Amgen’s Hunt for the Next Ozempic
top_signals.summary: Amgen's best chance at breaking into the high-stakes obesity drug market got its start in a basement at the University of Iceland Science Park in Reykjavík, in a freezer chilled to minus-13 degrees Fahrenheit. Bloomberg's Madison Muller explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: How elections worldwide are testing Trump’s influence abroad
top_signals.summary: Recent election losses by leaders linked to Trump have prompted questions about whether his influence over the global right is weakening.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
